ja318:1.1: Yan taṃ vasantasamaye kaṇaveresu bhānusu Sāmaṃ bāhāya pīḷesi sā taṃ ārogyam abruvīti.
ja318:2.1: Ambho na kira saddheyyaṃ yaṃ vāto pabbataṃ vahe, pabbataṃ ce vahe vāto sabbam pi paṭhaviṃ vahe, yattha Sāmā kālakatā sāmaṃ ārogyam abruvīti.
ja318:3.1: Na c' eva sā kālakatā, na ca sā aññam icchati, ekabhattakinī Sāmā tam evam abhikaṃkhatīti.
ja318:4.1: Asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena niminni Sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena, (cfr. p. mayāpi Sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan ti.
